timing: Frozen before the first real model observation. Original thirteen-case oracle files remain byte-identical.
interpretation: A missing acceptance alone is not a product defect, but an independently demonstrated static contradiction may coexist with that gap. The original first-case category is therefore not an exclusive category oracle: both coverage-gap and product-fail are accepted ONLY if the missing entry acceptance is explicitly identified. No other category flexibility is inferred. No post-observation expectation edits.
trust: A positive withdrawal fixture has an explicit trustworthy synthetic scope-owner record supplied by the harness outside the untrusted author packet. This is an assumption, not real customer consent, cryptographic provenance, a new production authentication feature, or permission for author records to authenticate themselves. Factual rejection can instead be verified from supplied static code. Missing/conditional/author-only approval cannot close a real obligation.
